## 2026-07-22 - Bind frontend bets to explicit epochs

- Added the additive `placeBatchBetsBitmapForEpoch` entrypoint while preserving
  all 138 V9 ABI items. Active epochs receive the bet directly. An expired empty
  epoch advances exactly once for the returning player; stale, closing, and
  expired funded epochs fail before stake transfer.

  every tile count. Auto-miner passes its planned epoch; manual betting reads the
  current epoch immediately before simulation. A cached on-chain bytecode check
  is the only condition that enables the V9 fallback. `UnexpectedEpoch` is classified as a deterministic

  advance, and stale/closing/expired-funded reverts. The one-call idle recovery
  costs 187,528 gas, about 23,888 less than separate empty-resolve and protected
  bet calls. Protected active bitmap overhead is 172-173 gas over the matching
  V10 bitmap path.
  A shared-loop A/B saved 36,309 deploy gas but added 44-45 gas to every user bet,
  so the canonical long-lived hot path remains inline.
- Canonical runtime is 16,302 bytes with 8,274 bytes EIP-170 headroom. The exact
  manifest, 25,330-mask invariants, business logic, and TypeScript checks pass;
  no transaction was signed or sent.

## Update Rule

Append only short entries that materially change current state, verification,
blockers, or the next step. Move completed history to a dated archive before this
file grows beyond a compact handoff.
## 2026-07-19 - Mutation-path and ambiguous-send hardening

- Audited every V9 claim, settlement, resolver-liability, fee-flush, and bet transfer path for replay, zero rounding, state-before-transfer ordering, and operational evidence.
- Mixed batch reward claims now skip zero-rounded payouts before closing state. Annual reward/rebate dust settlements are persisted by the indexer and compared against chain events.
- Ambiguous Privy silent-send timeouts now persist a nonce-only pending guard, preventing a manual repeat click from creating a second bet while the first send outcome is unknown.
- Batch bets now update epoch/user aggregate volume once per transaction instead of once per tile, avoiding up to 48 redundant aggregate storage rewrites for a 25-tile bet without changing accounting or ABI.
- Claim/indexer mutation audit: normalized batch-claim, resolver-reward, and dust-settlement evidence into scoped O(1) SQLite upserts; preserved legacy reads; fixed jackpot flags when award logs precede resolve; suppressed reward/rebate fallback resends after ambiguous wallet submission timeouts. Open launch gap: one-year claim window still exceeds the 5,000-epoch automatic discovery horizon.
- Contract/model logic, exact optimizer/Osaka compilation provenance, TypeScript, full lint, production HTTP smoke, and diff hygiene pass. Open product/protocol decisions remain documented in `docs/testnet-deep-audit-2026-07-19.md`.

## 2026-07-26 - Client address normalization hardening

- Extended the shared chat wallet normalizer into the chat profile and send
  hooks, so local cache keys, profile API calls, optimistic messages, and saved
  chat messages use the same EVM address parser as chat auth/session routes.
- Hardened rebate, reward-scan, and deposit client cache keys to normalize
  wallet addresses through `getAddress` before storing or reading localStorage.
  This prevents checksum-case or malformed local input from creating stale
  duplicate cache buckets before the final mainnet wallet tests.
- Chat unread counters and message ownership styling now use the same normalizer
  before comparing senders, preventing valid checksum variants from being
  displayed as another user's messages.
- Analytics achievement storage keys now normalize wallet addresses and fail
  closed for malformed local input instead of creating an invalid cache bucket.
- `/api/rewards` and the shared reward summary loader now normalize requested
  users through `getAddress`, matching the claim/rebate/deposit routes instead
  of accepting only manually lowercased regex input.
- Header wallet copy and explorer actions now expose explicit accessible names,
  so the Privy address controls are usable by assistive tech even when the
  visible text is only a shortened address or an icon.
- Pending mining transaction recovery now normalizes the contract and actor
  address through `getAddress` before localStorage keying, sanitization, and
  reload comparison. This keeps duplicate-send protection and nonce recovery
  tied to canonical EVM addresses.
- Privy wallet selection now normalizes embedded, external, and active signer
  addresses before comparison, including the wallet-list fallback when the
  injected provider does not expose selected accounts yet.
- Chat auth refresh now reuses the shared wallet-address normalizer and fails
  closed on malformed local input. Deposit history fetch/cache state also
  canonicalizes the user address before request dedupe, API calls, and cache
  timestamp bookkeeping.
- Recent wins and leaderboard public aggregate builders now normalize stored

## 2026-07-27 - Shared signed-proof replay lock

- Production deployments with two or more web replicas now acquire the existing
  Upstash-compatible store's atomic `SET NX PX` lock for chat/admin signed
  proofs and the bootstrap-resolver epoch. This closes the gap where a local
  SQLite lock could not span separate web processes and cause either session
  replay or competing keeper writes. Single-replica deployments retain the
  existing SQLite path.

  are not exposed in the external key. Multi-replica lock failures remain
  fail-closed through the required external-store configuration.
- Focused business logic, TypeScript, and ESLint checks pass.

  treated as successful resolution.

  cooldown, preventing distinct address requests from fanning out concurrent
  historical log scans. Deferred recovery remains marked as needed so the
  cache watermark is not presented as fully current.
